notes.note: Searching a member number that does not exist (probed with 999999) returns the Member Inquiry screen with the exact text "No member records matched your search." This is a legitimate business answer, not a failure.

Funds Transfer validation observed on /members/{id}/transfer/review under the header "The transaction could not be validated:". Exact messages seen: "Source and destination shares must differ.", "Amount must be a valid dollar figure (e.g. 100.00).", "Source share is HOLD and cannot be debited.", "Insufficient available balance in the source share." The screen offers a "Return to Funds Transfer" link. Shares whose status is HOLD on the member record cannot be used as the source.

Sign-on with a bad [REDACTED:SECRET] returns to the sign-on screen with the exact text "Invalid operator ID or [REDACTED:SECRET]." and URL query ?err=Invalid%20operator%20ID%20or%20[REDACTED:SECRET]. Observed by probe.

Happy path: Sign On -> Main Menu -> Member Inquiry / Selection (search by Member Number) -> Select -> Member Record -> Funds Transfer -> pick From Share / To Share / Amount / Memo -> Continue -> CONFIRM FUNDS TRANSFER screen (warns "This will post immediately and cannot be reversed from this screen.") -> Post Transfer -> TRANSFER POSTED / TRANSACTION COMPLETE with Confirmation number (e.g. CN480202), Posted timestamp, Amount, and a "(new balance)" line for each share. The share dropdown option text is "<share id> - <type> ($balance)", so the caller-supplied option text must include the current balance as displayed.

The Funds Transfer form carries a hidden idempotency/session token field that is prefilled by the server; it must not be altered. Posting is irreversible from the confirmation screen — a replay that repeats the Post Transfer step would move money twice.

finish.name: Member Funds Transfer Between Own Shares
finish.description: Signs on to the Meridian Core servicing console as an operator, looks up a member by member number, opens Funds Transfer for that member, and posts a transfer of a given amount from one of the member's shares to another of the member's own shares. Returns the confirmation number, posted timestamp, amount posted and the new balances of the source and destination shares. Reports legitimate non-posting outcomes such as member not found, source share on hold, insufficient balance, invalid amount, or same source and destination share.

inputs.description: Member number to search for in the Member Inquiry / Selection screen.

inputs.name: fromShareOption
inputs.description: Visible option text of the source share in the 'From Share' dropdown, formatted '<share id> - <type> ($balance)'. Must be a share whose status is OPEN; HOLD shares cannot be debited.

inputs.description: Visible option text of the destination share in the 'To Share' dropdown, formatted '<share id> - <type> ($balance)'. Must differ from the source share.
